content: Evolution API v2 groups: GET /group/fetchAllGroups/{instance}?getParticipants=false returns array with id (JID ending @g.us), subject, owner, size, creation. Known bug (issue 2124) - fetchAllGroups sometimes returns entries with null subject/creation; /group/findGroupInfos?groupJid= fixes only some. POST /message/sendMedia/{instance} with body {number: '<groupJid>@g.us', mediatype: image|video|document, media: '<public https url>' or base64, mimetype, fileName, caption, delay(ms)}; POST /message/sendText/{instance} with {number, text}. Response contains key{remoteJid,fromMe,id}, status (PENDING then SERVER_ACK), messageTimestamp, instanceId. Group sends are known to HTTP-timeout while still delivering (issue 1499).
